note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative: the performances are generic placeholders, never real contract text. Every relation is a plain relation (no arrowhead, no causality); a link means only "linked as supplied": no exchange that is due, no condition, no dependency, no order of performance, no breach, remedy or termination, and no jurisdiction is stated. The two markers run on both sides at once: neither side is first. Brief customizable fields not exposed (coordinator decision BRIEF CUSTOMIZABLE FIELDS, SESSION_HANDOFF 2026-10-05): clauses (the performances stand for the clauses), schedules, definitions, priorities (no priority between the columns is drawn) and elements (the elements are the motif's own objects — contract plate, two columns, cards, parties — whose texts are editable through contract, columns, performancesA/B and parties).
